chapters.title: R2: parked rows grow without bound
chapters.prose:
Today a parked row stays in the table forever. A long outage can park thousands of rows.

A fix needs a schema change to add a parked-at date. Then a job can drop old rows. This is why the question in panel A is open.

chapters.title: What was done and what was found
chapters.prose:
The outbox table and the sender loop are done. The retry delay is in progress and needs its cap.

The review found one real gap, the parked row growth. The other risks are known and have no fix yet.
